account_creator: x402 is an open HTTP payment protocol, not a hosted marketplace account. The whitepaper states it removes the need for API keys, accounts, and subscriptions. The party that can receive funds is the holder of the payTo wallet address. A human (or a legal entity authorized operator) must control that wallet; an AI agent may attach a signed payment but should not be treated as the account owner of a bank-style payout identity.
disclosure_rule: Designed for AI agents to pay autonomously. A 402 response may include a description of the resource. Wallet confirmation screens are specified to show the request domain, payment amount, token, and resource. There is no AI-content publishing label; x402 is a payment rail.
payout_kyc: Onchain settlement to a wallet. The whitepaper states: no PCI compliance required for developers unless a facilitator accepts cards directly; no reliance on banks or third-party approvals. Payments settle onchain (example given: about 200 ms on Base) and are described as not reversible / no chargebacks. This is not a substitute for KYC on any fiat on-ramp or hosted facilitator you choose to use.
copyright_notes: The whitepaper does not grant copyright in paid content. USCO Part 2 (January 2025) still applies to any literary or artistic work delivered after an x402 payment: purely AI-generated material is not copyrightable; prompts alone are not enough.
human_must: Control the receiving wallet (and any facilitator account) as a human or authorized entity operator.
Decide whether a hosted facilitator re-introduces KYC or card-network rules.
Do not treat protocol-level no-account as permission for an AI to open bank or exchange accounts.
quote: With this simple protocol, x402 removes the need for API keys, accounts, and subscriptions. x402 enables any API or content provider to accept pay-per-use payments through a lightweight middleware that integrates seamlessly into existing infrastructures.

additional_sources.quote: No PCI compliance required for developers, unless a facilitator chooses to accept card payments directly. No reliance on banks or third-party approvals, ensuring global, permissionless access.
x402 is an open payment standard that enables AI agents and web services to autonomously pay for API access, data, and digital services.

notes: Whitepaper dated May 6, 2025; PDF hosted under /2026/06/ on x402.org as fetched 2026-08-16.
